package clauderuntime

import "strings"

func runtimeScript(state, checkout, keySource string) string {
	return `#!/bin/sh
STATE=` + shQuote(state) + `
CWD=` + shQuote(checkout) + `
KEYSRC=` + shQuote(keySource) + `
if [ "$1" = "--version" ]; then
  echo ` + shQuote(VersionOutput()) + `
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$1" = "auth" ] && [ "$2" = "status" ]; then
  echo ` + shQuote(AuthStatusJSON) + `
  exit 0
fi
n=0
if [ -f "$STATE/calls" ]; then n=$(cat "$STATE/calls"); fi
n=$((n+1))
echo "$n" > "$STATE/calls"
cat > "$STATE/prompt-$n.bin"
sid=
prev=
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$prev" in
    --session-id|--resume) sid=$a ;;
  esac
  prev=$a
done
printf '{"type":"system","subtype":"init","cwd":"%s","session_id":"%s","mcp_servers":[],"permissionMode":"acceptEdits","apiKeySource":"%s","claude_code_version":"` + initVersion() + `","model":"claude-sonnet-5-5"}\n' "$CWD" "$sid" "$KEYSRC"
if [ -f "$STATE/round-$n.jsonl" ]; then ` + roundOutputCmd() + `; fi
exit 0
`
}

func shQuote(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", `'\''`) + "'" }
